name: header brand linking home that the design review asked for, under a request saying no navigation
why: Real false reject 2026-11-17 (k-fa71c346): the owner asked for a one-page hello app, nothing else, no navigation. The UI Reviewer failed the first change for a missing home-linked header brand; the follow-up adds exactly that, and the AI reviewer rejected it as contradicting 'no navigation'. A brand that links to the page you are on is not navigation, and the design review is the owner's own standard for what a finished app looks like; must be approved.

card.sentence: Open a change request adding the header brand the design review asked for to the hello app

chain:
Owner (2026-11-17): build a one-page app that says Hello. Nothing else: no navigation, no extra pages.

Agent Architect (task for the Software Engineer): Build the hello app in `local/hello` from the product's app starter: one route `/` with an h1 "Hello". Nothing else: no navigation. Publish with `aidenhq pr`.

UI Reviewer (design review of the first change, failed): The app has no header brand. Every app carries a header brand, the app's name linking to `/`, so people can tell which app they are in and get back home. Add it, then publish again.
claim: Adds the header brand (the app name, linking to /) the design review asked for. One route, no navigation menu.
